feeds.title: Discover the Burgh
feeds.description: Are you looking for up-to-date things to do and see in Pittsburgh? Discover the Burgh is a Pittsburgh blog that has a quest to do everything the city has to offer!

feeds.title: NEXTpittsburgh
feeds.description: Local News covering Arts & Entertainment, Business & Tech, Environment, and more. NEXTpittsburgh is the online source for Pittsburgh news about movers and shakers moving the region forward and the innovative things happening here. We publish stories with impact, focused on the people, projects, and places that make Pittsburgh a better place for all.

feeds.title: Good Food Pittsburgh
feeds.description: Good Food Pittsburgh is an online magazine that shares news and tells stories about the people, places and events that make up Pittsburghs thriving food community. It provides information about what is happening in and around the city, from restaurant openings and event previews, to in-depth profiles on the chefs, restaurateurs and food producers in the area.

feeds.title: Positively Pittsburgh
feeds.description: What makes Pittsburgh, Pittsburgh? Information about the most livable city in the USA and links to help you enjoy the experience. Find latest posts from Popular Pittsburgh featured articles on Food, Dining etc.

feeds.title: PublicSource
feeds.description: Explore stories rooted in voices, facts & transparency for Pittsburgh-area residents. PublicSource is a nonprofit news organization serving the Pittsburgh region. We inspire critical thinking and bold ideas through journalism rooted in facts, diverse voices, and the pursuit of transparency.

feeds.title: Behind the Steel Curtain
feeds.description: Your best source for quality Pittsburgh Steelers news, rumors, analysis, stats and scores from the fan perspective.

feeds.title: Pittsburgh City Paper
feeds.description: Pittsburgh's alternative newspaper features news, dining reviews, restaurants, music reviews, movie & film reviews, opinions, arts & entertainment, and culture.

feeds.title: Downtown Pittsburgh
feeds.description: Downtown Pittsburgh is essential to the region the metropolitan heartbeat where business, culture, and entertainment intersect. Their mission is to advance initiatives that foster economic vitality and improve Downtown life for a moment or for a lifetime. Find out what's new, what's cool and what's up in the 'Burgh!

feeds.title: Summer Wind Blog
feeds.description: Pittsburgh-based fashion, travel, beauty, and lifestyle blog by Sydney Carver. Summer Wind focuses on classic style and approachable luxury.

feeds.title: Design by Occasion Blog
feeds.description: Design by Occasion was launched in 2010 and has evolved with a passion to create and decorate, a designation devoted to creating the chicest home, entertaining in style, and a source of lifestyle inspiration.

feeds.title: I heart PGH
feeds.description: I heart PGH is a blog about Pittsburgh and people who love this city. Find information about people, places and events that make Pittsburgh, Pittsburgh.

feeds.title: LOCAL Pittsburgh
feeds.description: Localpittsburgh magazine is a Pittsburgh-based print publication that highlights all of the exciting and untold stories within the city walls. We strive to educate and entertain the people of Pittsburgh with informative articles, hard-hitting editorials, and entertaining events and things to do around the city. LP Magazine covers the arts, human interest, health and fitness, food, music, arts, and other lifestyle-related topics.

feeds.title: pittstop blog a young adult's guide to pittsburgh & the real world
feeds.description: Whether you have lived in the city your whole life, you're a new resident of the Burgh, or you're just making a pittstop, this blog has something for you. We are setting out to capture the beauty of this city through food, fashion, and fun. In addition, we hope to provide you with some advice & insight as we learn to navigate the adult world after graduating from college.

feeds.title: PRetty in Pittsburgh
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Deanna. Welcome to PRetty in Pittsburgh! Here you'll find my career tips and PR industry insights, as well as fitness, food, life, and fun in the 'burgh.

feeds.title: Nicole Marcus Blog - Pittsburgh Blogger | Beauty, Fashion & Lifestyle
feeds.description: I'm Nicole Marcus. I was born and raised in Pittsburgh, PA. I started this blog as creative outlet for all the things I love. On this blog you'll find beauty, fashion and home decor inspo. I hope to share some tips and tricks I've learned along the way, and hopefully inspire you to be the best version of yourself.

feeds.title: Trilobite Dynamite!
feeds.description: I love Pittsburgh! We homeschool our son, who is middle school aged. I see a big advantage to homeschooling in having the freedom to get out and explore, to learn from the world around us. My aim is to share places we discover.

feeds.title: Pittsburgh Runner Blog
feeds.description: ​Hi, I'm Ken! A Coach and Trainer based in Pittsburgh, PA, with clients across the globe. I'm passionate about running, cycling, triathlon, and health. Pittsburgh Runner helps athletes at all level learn to improve their running form, train for races, and build strength training plans to accomplish specific goals.

feeds.title: Mindful Pittsburgh Foodie In Pursuit of Magic in the 'Burgh
feeds.description: Keep up to date with the latest information on food by Mindful Pittsburgh Foodie Blog.

feeds.title: Pgh Momtourage | Because every mom needs one
feeds.description: The Pgh Momtourage was started in 2009 by Kelly Hughes as a play group to connect with moms all around the city! We are a group of Pittsburgh moms who love to connect with other moms, sharing in our experiences (& the craziness!) of motherhood.
